terminus.generated: Activation capacity has at least two scales: locally embedded capacity and transferable field/network capacity. Repeated participation can deplete the first while strengthening the second. Capacity therefore may migrate across scale and carrier rather than simply grow or decay.
terminus.relationToPrevious: Revises the previous feedback model by adding scale and carrier. Participation is not a single stock: local capacity may collapse while movement knowledge, methods and organizational capacity survive elsewhere.
